description: This file defines an AuditEngine class that applies audit rules to invoices, validates data consistency, performs benchmark checks, and computes a purchase audit report. It interacts with database models to read invoice and line item data, compute findings, and persist audit results.

classes.name: FindingSpec
classes.description: Data class representing a specific audit finding, including code, message, severity, and optional line item ID.

classes.name: AuditEngine
classes.description: Main class responsible for executing audit rules on invoices, including validation, benchmarking, and computing purchase audit sections.

methods.name: Tuple[List[AuditFinding],Dict] run(self, invoice_id: str)
methods.description: Executes the audit process for a specific invoice ID, returns findings and purchase audit summary.

methods.name: List[FindingSpec] _required_fields(self, invoice: Invoice)
methods.description: Checks for missing required invoice fields and returns corresponding findings.

methods.name: List[FindingSpec] _totals_checks(self, invoice: Invoice, items: List[LineItem])
methods.description: Validates subtotal, total, and grand total consistency and returns findings.

methods.name: List[FindingSpec] _high_value_items(self, items: List[LineItem])
methods.description: Identifies line items exceeding a value threshold.

methods.name: List[FindingSpec] _benchmark_price_checks(self, items: List[LineItem], benchmarks: List[Benchmark])
methods.description: Compares line item prices against benchmark data and reports discrepancies.

methods.name: Dict _compute_purchase_audit(self, invoice: Invoice, items: List[LineItem])
methods.description: Builds a purchase audit section with inferred tax rates and consistency checks per line item.

ctags.name: _benchmark_price_checks
ctags.pattern: /^    def _benchmark_price_checks(self, items: List[LineItem], benchmarks: List[Benchmark]) -> Lis/

ctags.name: _compute_purchase_audit
ctags.pattern: /^    def _compute_purchase_audit(self, invoice: Invoice, items: List[LineItem]) -> Dict:$/

ctags.name: _totals_checks
ctags.pattern: /^    def _totals_checks(self, invoice: Invoice, items: List[LineItem]) -> List[FindingSpec]:$/

ctags.name: run
ctags.pattern: /^    async def run(self, invoice_id: str) -> Tuple[List[AuditFinding], Dict]:$/
